name: Keyhole
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. that unlocks food dispensers, medical supply cabinets, and shelter access points in Tier 1 zones after midnight. Re-locks before the next audit cycle.
observed_behavior: Overrides access controls on specific dispensers between 0100-0400. Targets locations with high foot traffic from unregistered populations. Leaves no audit trail.
location: The Shelf, The Narrows, Old Harbor perimeter
story_hooks: A night-shift security guard notices the pattern and has to decide whether to report it or look the other way
